name: Privi Call
intro: One answer before each call: is the number on your do-not-call list, is it within calling hours where the person is, and do you hold the consent the call needs. Numbers are stored only as scrambled fingerprints.

key.label: Prepaid call key
key.help: Your lists belong to your prepaid call key (pck_...). It is kept in this browser only and filled in for you.

features.title: Pre-call check
features.blurb: Go or no-go, with the reasons.

features.title: Do-Not-Call list
features.blurb: Add, remove or check a number.

features.title: Calling hours
features.blurb: Is it 8 a.m. to 9 p.m. where they are?

features.title: Consent records
features.blurb: Who agreed to what, and when.
